benefits.name: First Checked Bag Free
benefits.description: First standard checked bag free for the primary cardmember and up to 8 passengers on the same reservation.
benefits.terms: Applies to Southwest Airlines flights booked on the cardmember's reservation.

benefits.name: Anniversary Bonus Points
benefits.description: 3,000 bonus Rapid Rewards points each account anniversary year.
benefits.terms: Points post automatically each account anniversary year.

benefits.name: Companion Pass Qualifying Points Boost
benefits.description: One boost of 10,000 Companion Pass qualifying points each calendar year.
benefits.terms: Applies toward Southwest Companion Pass qualification, not toward redeemable Rapid Rewards points balance.

benefits.name: Annual Flight Discount
benefits.description: One 10% flight discount promo code each account anniversary year.

benefits.name: Preferred/Standard Seat Selection
benefits.description: Complimentary Standard seat selection when available, within 48 hours of departure, for the cardmember and up to 8 passengers on the same reservation.

benefits.name: Group 5 Boarding
benefits.description: Group 5 boarding position for the cardmember and up to 8 passengers on the same reservation.
